title: Yeasty Polish Galette
description: A traditional Polish dessert with a sweet, yeasty flavor and crunchy texture, featuring cinnamon and baked to perfection in a ttukbaegi-earthenware-cook.

ingredients.name: cinnamon stick
ingredients.notes: broke into pieces before adding to dough

instructions: Combine yeast and warm water in a small bowl, let sit for 5 minutes until frothy.
In a large mixing bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, and cinnamon stick pieces.
Add the egg, melted butter, and yeast mixture to the dry ingredients, mix until a sticky dough forms.
Knead the dough on a floured surface for 5 minutes until smooth, then place in a greased bowl, cover with plastic wrap, and let rise in a warm place for 1 hour, or until doubled in size.
Preheat a ttukbaegi-earthenware-cook over medium heat on the stovetop.
Divide the dough into 2 equal pieces, roll out each piece into a thin circle, place one circle in the preheated pot and top with the second circle, press edges together to seal the galette.
Bake for 20-25 minutes, or until the top is golden brown and the crisp edges are caramelized.
Let cool for 5 minutes before slicing and serving.
Serve warm, dust with powdered sugar if desired.
Serve with whipped cream or ice cream if preferred.
